prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a production transparent sprite atlas for a hand-painted historical maritime RPG. Exactly 24 separate full body poses in strict 6 columns x 4 rows, landscape canvas 2304x1536, each cell 384x384, clear gutters. Each pose wholly within its cell, entire head, hands, feet, and sword tip visible. Consistent same adult person, costume, proportions, camera and scale, facing RIGHT with side-three-quarter view. No grid, labels, captions, floor, shadows, backgrounds or lettering. Truly transparent alpha background. Detailed realistic painterly game art, no chibi. Adult clean-shaven dark-haired male explorer, open-neck white linen shirt, rolled sleeves, dark knee breeches, brown leather crossbelt, pouch and tall boots. Preserve reference face and outfit. Wield one simple naval cutlass. All 24 poses form four six-frame actions read left-to-right: row 1 overhead saber slash (ready, windup, high arc, downward cut, followthrough, recovery); row 2 horizontal thrust (guard, pull back, extend, full lunge, recoil, recovery); row 3 low sweeping cut (crouch windup, draw back, swing, extension, followthrough, recover); row 4 short pommel bash (guard, pull back, step in, pommel forward, followthrough, recover). Make limb and blade positions change clearly frame to frame. No motion trails.
